by

      | succ ϑ_pred =>

            intro u hu
            let u₀ : Word A ι := u 0
            let u₁ : Word A ι := u 1
            have hfin : finMapTwoWords u₀ u₁ = u := by

              fin_cases i <;> rfl
            rw [← hfin]
            apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
            rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card] at hu ⊢
            have hcard :

                      Δ₀(multilinearCombine u r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card =
                  (Finset.filter
                    (fun r : F =>
                      Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation u₀ u₁ r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card := by
              apply Finset.card_bij (fun r _ => r 0)
              · intro r hr
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
                rw [← hfin] at hr
                simpa [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, u₀, u₁] using hr
              · intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hrs
                funext i
                fin_cases i
                exact hrs
              · intro r hr
                refine ⟨fun _ => r, ?_, rfl⟩
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
                rw [← hfin]
                simpa [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, u₀, u₁] using hr
            simpa [hcard, Fintype.card_fun] using hu
          · have hϑ_pred_gt_0 : ϑ_pred > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hϑ_pred
            have ih_pred : δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
                (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ_pred)
                (e := e) (ε := ε) :=
              ih ϑ_pred (Nat.lt_succ_self ϑ_pred) hϑ_pred_gt_0
            unfold δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
            intro u hP
            let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).1
            let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).2
            let R := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
            have hcombine (r_last : F) (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) :

              simp [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, U₀, U₁,

            have hP' :

              rw [Pr_multi_let_equiv_single_let]
              rw [do_two_uniform_sampling_eq_uniform_prod]
              rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card]
              rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card] at hP
              have hcard :

                    Finset.univ).card =
                  (Finset.filter
                    (fun r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F =>
                      Δ₀(multilinearCombine u r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card := by

                · intro p hp

                  unfold multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close at hp
                  rw [hcombine]
                  exact hp
                · intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hp
                  apply Prod.ext
                  · exact congrFun hp (Fin.last ϑ_pred)
                  · funext i
                    exact congrFun hp i.castSucc
                · intro r hr
                  let p : F × (Fin ϑ_pred → F) :=

                  have hp_eq : Fin.lastCases p.1 p.2 = r := by

                    · simp [p]
                  refine ⟨p, ?_, hp_eq⟩

                  rw [← hcombine, hp_eq]

            have h_affine :

              apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies

              have hr_mem : r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁ := by

              have hr' := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor

            unfold jointProximityNat₂ at h_pair

                    simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at hi_total

            refine ⟨vflat, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp only [CodeInterleavable.interleaveCode,

              intro i
              by_cases hi : i.val < half

              · have hi_inner : i.val - half < half := by

                  dsimp only [half] at hi_total ⊢
                  simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at hi_total
                  omega
                simpa [vflat, hi, hi_inner] using
                  hv (1 : Fin 2) ⟨i.val - half, hi_inner⟩
            · have hdist :
                  Δ₀(⋈| u, vflat) =

                unfold hammingDist
                congr 1
                ext j
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
                apply not_congr
                constructor
                · intro hflat
                  funext k t
                  fin_cases k
                  · have ht : t.val < 2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1) := by
                      have ht' := t.isLt
                      simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
                      omega
                    have hj := congrFun hflat
                      (⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1)))
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave] using hj
                  · have ht : t.val + half < 2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1) := by
                      have ht' := t.isLt
                      dsimp only [half] at ht' ⊢
                      simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
                      omega
                    have hj := congrFun hflat
                      (⟨t.val + half, ht⟩ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1)))
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave] using hj
                · intro hnested

                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
